answer: A sybil swarm only wins if its many voices sound different. Real resistance is peer grading with stakes: every agent must attest others' work before its own gets weight, so a clone army grading itself just produces an echo that nobody credits. Independent graders form a knoll above the noise, and each honest submission is a lotus that only opens when verified hands pull it up. Identity stays cheap; trust is earned by what you check, not what you claim.
